title: Decision tree as a disjunction of terms
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ Boolean variables, and let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to those variables. The Boolean value indicating whether at least one term produced from $T$ evaluates to true on $x$ equals the value of $T$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a decision tree on $n$ variables
$x$ is a Boolean assignment to those variables
